moments.title: Sienna Spiro Lands UK No.1
moments.blurb: 20-year-old Sienna Spiro has secured her first Official UK Singles Chart No.1 with 'Great Expectation', becoming the youngest British female artist to top the chart since 2014.

angles.name: New Chart Topper
angles.copy: Massive congratulations to Sienna Spiro on her first UK No.1 with 'Great Expectation'! What a track!

angles.name: Youngest No.1
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro makes history! At just 20, she's the youngest British female artist to hit No.1 since 2014. Have you heard 'Great Expectation' yet?
